title: xAI Grok 4.6 now available as a Databricks-hosted model
body:
Model Serving now supports xAI [Grok 4.6](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#grok-4-6) as a Databricks-hosted model. This reasoning model has a 500,000-token context window and supports configurable reasoning effort and function calling for coding, agentic workflows, and other complex tasks. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
